verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an official MCP server on a dedicated overview page, confirmed by a probe. It names supported clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode) and has a shopping-agent MCP use-case guide that works without code or an API key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP connection works, and evidence detailing the exposed tools and setup steps.
